verdict: Digitally reviewed release candidate for a short free adult-led printable adventure. Complete paper-only play is supported when the adult has the guide. Physical print/cut and unfamiliar-family playtesting remain unverified.
reviewed: Four final PDFs, 22 rendered pages, shared story/puzzle source and browser answer checks.
findingsFixed: Original 180pt-wide module cut rectangles exceeded the printed board slots. Reduced complete cards to 106pt wide (37.39mm); A4 slots are approximately 39.93mm wide. Increased symbol and label sizes to retain legibility.
Added an explicit adult supply list, colour-optional instruction and inner-window cutting responsibility.
Specified the handoff after every checked puzzle, including page 7 after the lens, and explicit paper-only answer checking.
Changed the third-person opening heading from a letter attribution to Your lighthouse mission.
checksPassed: All 22 final pages visually inspected; enlarged module sheet and shortest-format adult preparation page reviewed.
No visible clipped text, overlaps, missing symbols or broken page references found. Extracted text stays within page-safe margins.
A4 and US Letter shipped text matches after paper-name and whitespace normalization.
All six actual PDF card transforms fit the board slots, including cutting tolerance.
Lens board and mask have matching 420pt image transforms and 30mm calibration labels.
Journal has one order; eight possible module selections contain one valid answer; four lens orientations contain one matching sequence. Finale requires direction and code.
Player pack does not include TMRK or 427 answer strings; adult guide provides hints, solutions, ending and certificate.
Production build and 14 relevant game/link tests passed.
userJourney: Adult reads the four-page guide, prints seven single-sided player pages at 100% in one paper size, and cuts the journal, modules and lens.
Give players pages 1-2, then pages 3-4 after checking the journal, pages 5-6 after checking power, and page 7 after checking the lens.
Keep findings on page 1, offer progressive hints, check the final combination, then read guide page 4 and award the certificate.
limitations: No physical printer/scissor trial was performed; digital geometry does not prove every printer's scaling or paper handling.
No new-user family test establishes actual duration, reading difficulty or age suitability. The 7-12 range is a design target.
This is a short introductory game with three puzzles and a synthesis finale; do not position it as a long or difficult escape-room product.
deployment: Not deployed; updated files and rebuilt preview are local. Existing Home/Classroom games are unchanged.
